name: outreach-console-mcp
description: Operate a local job-application outreach pipeline with explicit provider and send controls.
long_description: Connects an AI assistant to a local company-centric outreach backend. Application tracking and aggregate status are read-only by default. Contact PII, mailbox content, paid enrichment, email-provider drafts, AI writing, and live sends are disabled unless explicitly enabled. External and state-changing actions require short-lived confirmation tokens bound to the exact arguments.

tools.name: outreach_health
tools.description: Check local backend and provider readiness.

tools.name: outreach_setup_status
tools.description: Show routing, resume, sample-mode, and send-lock status.

tools.name: outreach_provider_check
tools.description: Run provider setup checks without spending credits.

tools.name: outreach_dashboard
tools.description: Show statuses, moving activity averages, and provider usage.

tools.name: outreach_list_companies
tools.description: List normalized companies and operational counts.

tools.name: outreach_get_company
tools.description: Show company, job, contact, and outreach detail (opt-in PII).

tools.name: outreach_list_exceptions
tools.description: List open recovery and exception cases.

tools.name: outreach_incident_report
tools.description: Return health, exceptions, logs, and current metrics.

tools.name: outreach_get_run
tools.description: Inspect a persisted batch or replay run.

tools.name: outreach_mailbox_events
tools.description: Read locally ingested mailbox events (opt-in PII/content).

tools.name: outreach_import_applications
tools.description: Import normalized application rows (confirm).

tools.name: outreach_submit_shadow_batch
tools.description: Create a non-sending run plan (confirm).

tools.name: outreach_enrich_company
tools.description: Run the configured contact provider, optionally spending credits (confirm).

tools.name: outreach_sync_mailbox
tools.description: Read configured mailboxes and optionally apply matched state changes (confirm).

tools.name: outreach_create_draft
tools.description: Create a profile-routed email-provider draft (confirm).

tools.name: outreach_send_email
tools.description: Send one profile-routed email (live opt-in plus confirm).

tools.name: outreach_list_message_drafts
tools.description: List recipient-level writing drafts (opt-in PII).

tools.name: outreach_save_message_draft
tools.description: Save one recipient-level message for review (confirm).

tools.name: outreach_generate_messages
tools.description: Generate reviewed message copy through the configured writing helper (confirm).

tools.name: outreach_set_company_suppression
tools.description: Pause or resume company outreach (confirm).

tools.name: outreach_resolve_exception
tools.description: Complete, dismiss, or defer a recovery case (confirm).

backend_url.title: Local backend URL
backend_url.description: URL of the running Outreach Console backend.

max_rows.title: Maximum rows returned
max_rows.description: Caps list responses sent into the AI conversation.

expose_contacts.title: Expose recruiter contacts
expose_contacts.description: Enables tools that return recruiter names and email addresses. Off by default.

expose_mailbox.title: Expose mailbox events
expose_mailbox.description: Enables tools that return sender details and message previews. Off by default.

enable_provider_actions.title: Enable provider actions
enable_provider_actions.description: Allows confirmed contact, mailbox, writing, and email-provider operations. Off by default.

enable_live_send.title: Enable live email sends
enable_live_send.description: Allows the send tool to reach the backend. The backend live-send lock and confirmation are still required. Off by default.
